what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to send a letter telling Simon-Pure it cannot operate after January 1 and must reapply for licenses before the board.
The board approved a new common victualler license for KCM Donuts, doing business as Dunkin Donuts, at 400 Electric Ave.
It renewed four common victualler licenses, plus the all-alcohol, amusement device, jukebox and weekday entertainment licenses for Bad Larry's and Donnelly's Tavern.
The board said it will revisit the jukebox license requirement and fee early in the new year.
The next meeting is set for the first Tuesday in January, with an open forum to follow the town manager's budget and five-year plan presentation.

why_it_matters: Licenses decide which businesses may legally serve food, sell alcohol or run entertainment in town, and the Simon-Pure letter means that business must go back before the board to keep operating.

A possible change to the jukebox requirement and fee could alter what local bars and restaurants pay, and residents will have a chance to comment on the town manager's budget and five-year plan at the planned open forum.
